## Checklist

- [ ] Light and dark appearance checked, with a screenshot or clip for visual changes
- [ ] Reduce Motion, Reduce Transparency and VoiceOver still work for what changed
- [ ] README and `docs/SPEC.md` updated, if behavior changed
- [ ] No selected text logged or stored
